comparison_meta.core_finding: Empirical Geofencing Privacy Arbitrage confirmed: Miro applies divergent CMP configurations and script blocking policies based on visitor GeoIP.

pre_consent_cookies.interpretation: GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) data minimization strictly enforced on European route; domestic Indian route deposits marketing/analytics cookies unconsented.

onetrust_active_groups.interpretation: All tracking categories pre-activated on Indian route (implied consent); only strictly necessary C0001 active on EU route (prior opt-in).

first_layer_reject_all.interpretation: Equal prominence 'Tout refuser' present on EU first layer; omitted on Indian banner, creating asymmetric choice under Dark Patterns Guidelines 2023.

pre_consent_third_party_ad_trackers.interpretation: Behavioral analytics and third-party ad sync beacons fire immediately in India prior to interaction; completely suppressed on EU route.

post_action_behavior.MIRO-IN-001: Accept All -> 65 Cookies (+10 released including Google DoubleClick IDE)
post_action_behavior.MIRO-EU-001: Tout refuser -> 10 Cookies (+1 preference cookie only; clean rejection maintained)
post_action_behavior.interpretation: Affirmative consent mechanism reliably gates DoubleClick, but selective application demonstrates deliberate regional policy divergence.

eu_gdpr.summary: Technical controls meet CJEU Planet49 and EDPB Guidelines 05/2020 standard for valid prior freely given consent.

india_dpdpa.applicable_statute: DPDP Act 2023 Sec. 6 & Consumer Protection Act 2019 (Dark Patterns Guidelines 2023)
india_dpdpa.summary: Non-essential pre-consent tracking and omission of equal-prominence rejection raise prospective DPDPA Sec. 6 compliance risk upon completion of the 18-month phased commencement schedule.
